title: Singari Bangari
desc: Singari and Bangari are best friends who always support each other. However, when Singari becomes a victim of child abuse and suffers mental trauma, Bangari vows to help him recover.

title: Gandhada Gudi
desc: When forest officer Kumar protects natural resources from poachers, their boss, Anand, becomes his main rival. But little does Kumar know that Anand is his brother.

title: Sose Tanda Soubhagya
desc: Two women marry in the same family. While one tries to separate them, the other wishes to keep them united and strong against all odds.

title: Rowdy
desc: Anna rules over Rayalaseema with a good heart. However, when a project threatens the well-being of his people, he does everything he can to oppose it and angers dangerous people as a result.

title: Dosti
desc: When four college friends come to know that one of their classmates did not commit suicide but instead was killed by an MLA's men, they plan an act of revenge against him.
